messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "dispose through a medicine take-back program at a US DEA authorized collection site"
set: ["dispose through a medicine take-back program at a US DEA authorized collection site", "ask your pharmacist about a drug take-back program", "ask pharmacist about drug take-back disposal program", "report symptoms at injection site", "US clinical trial", "do this if no take-back program or DEA-authorized collector is available", "swelling or blisters at the application site", "use a medicine dose-measuring device", "DEA Controlled Substances Act", "choose site at least two inches from belly button", "this mixture can be given through a nasogastric (ng) feeding tube", "complete treatment program", "hypertension treatment program", "use a special dose-measuring spoon or medicine cup", "can stop breastfeeding or take a different medicine", "not a fast-acting rescue medicine for asthma attacks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
